question: Which single self-hostable font family, if any, best realizes TYP-02 F1 Ratio Ladder across the completed Kymaean app shell and current Website text context while remaining subordinate to O3/C0/Stage and preserving reflow/accessibility?
controlled_inputs: TYP-02 F1 Ratio Ladder role order eyebrow < state/support <= body < heading
completed COMP shell roles and Light F2/Dark D3 static app system
current Website V2.2 supporting-copy context; O3 wordmark/Threshold K geometry remains unchanged
one identical content packet per candidate
same font sizes, weights, line-heights, tracking, layout and color roles for every candidate

candidate_application.heading: 650 1.5rem/1.15
candidate_application.font_optical_sizing: auto for all candidates; ignored when unsupported

comparison_surfaces: real-shell-derived APP surface with navigation, current task, inspector/support, state labels, buttons and Æ fallback sample
current-production-derived WEB surface with preserved Threshold K/O3 identity treatment and candidate applied only to supporting text
mechanical_falsifiers: font fails to load or computed candidate family does not apply
horizontal page/internal overflow in any matrix case
unnamed button or undersized icon control introduced by carrier
TYP F1 hierarchy collapses mechanically under 200% text or spacing stress
visual_falsifiers: typography becomes the primary identity carrier or competes with O3/C0/Stage
app reads generic SaaS/dashboard/AI-tech rather than quiet authored creative software
website drifts into luxury-serif/fashion/editorial shorthand or generic startup typography
state/support labels become instrumentation-heavy or headings become shouty
body text loses calm readability or dense/narrow app copy becomes tiring
family-specific metrics materially flatten the F1 Ratio Ladder
candidate feels conspicuously accessibility-specialized rather than naturally legible
selection_law: No candidate-specific retune after exposure. Reject any mechanically failed candidate. Apply recursive visual falsification to survivors. If exactly one materially survives, Design Sol may promote it under standing delegation. If two or more remain materially valid and the difference is taste rather than falsification, stop for Director choice. Zero survivors closes without selection.
non_authority: No wordmark/O3 or Threshold K redesign.
No color/material/state/Stage/component/layout change except uniform responsive containment repair required by the common carrier.
No production font packaging, native WinUI/XAML mapping, Store claim, website deployment, trademark or final identity authority.
No Product semantics, motion, Stage interaction or COMP-12.
